description: Decodes an x402 payment challenge (base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, or the JSON; v2 `amount` and v1 `maxAmountRequired`) into networks, assets, human amounts and payTo. A challenge with no payment options fails (not charged). Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

challenge.description: Base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED value, challenge JSON text, or the challenge object.
